sources.title: Think Fast: LPU Accelerator for Heterogeneous Compute
sources.data_kind: manufacturer-reported SRAM-to-SRAM network timing; measurement conditions unspecified
sources.use: Explicit 0.35-us mapping sensitivity in AA and native/replay LPX studies.
